stories.title: Lost Italian Statue by Trevi Fountain Artist Discovered in Salvage Yard Among the Garden Ornaments
stories.label: world
stories.summary: A beautiful piece of art history nearly slipped away unnoticed. A small bronze model, created centuries ago by Pietro Bracci, the same sculptor behind Rome's famous Trevi Fountain, turned up sitting among garden ornaments in a salvage yard. It was being sold for about $400, a tiny fraction of its true worth. Experts have now confirmed its origins, meaning this lost treasure gets a second life being properly appreciated. It's a lovely reminder that history sometimes hides in the most unexpected places.
stories.why_good: A genuine historical rediscovery that happened, preserving cultural heritage without any controversy or harm involved.

stories.title: Giant Tortoise Population is Thriving – Survey Finds 180,000 on One Island Chain
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: Scientists just finished counting the giant tortoises on Aldabra, a remote atoll in the Seychelles, and found about 180,000 of them living there. That's the highest number ever recorded and makes it the largest population of free-roaming giant tortoises left on Earth. These gentle giants were once hunted to the edge of extinction, so seeing their numbers this strong is a real conservation win. It shows that protecting a place and leaving animals alone to live and breed in peace can truly work wonders over time.
stories.why_good: Confirms a real, measured recovery of an endangered species in the wild, based on an actual completed survey rather than a prediction.

stories.title: New Way to Relieve Arthritic Knees Without Drugs or Surgery by Changing Your Gait
stories.label: health
stories.summary: Researchers found that a simple change in the way people walk can ease the pain of knee arthritis just as well as medication does, without any pills or surgery involved. Nearly a quarter of people over 40 deal with this kind of joint pain, so a free, drug-free option is a big deal. The approach also appears to slow down the wear and tear on the cartilage itself, not just mask the pain. That means relief now and possibly healthier knees down the road. It's a hopeful, low-cost option for millions of achy knees.
stories.why_good: A real study showed a practical, accessible, drug-free way to reduce arthritis pain and protect joint health, which is genuinely good news for people's bodies and wallets.
